fit_reason: Whole passenger car listed by a private seller.
findings: Black hood looks dull and hazy in the straight-on front shot, with uneven reflections suggesting light swirling
Light dust and film on the front bumper and lower grille area

message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Cruze. It looks to be in good shape, but in the front photo the black hood looks a little dull and the headlights have a slight haze, which black paint tends to show in pictures. We do mobile pre-sale details, including a buff and headlight touch-up, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
